kjv: ye (Moses and Aaron) rebelled against my commandment ... to sanctify me at the water
mine: you (Moses and Aaron) rebelled against My command ... instead of treating Me as holy through the water
note: Hebrew lehaqdisheni is elliptical: the command was to treat God as holy, which they failed to do (cf. 20:12); the KJV's literal infinitive reads as though the rebellion served to sanctify him.
